question: What project lifetime, discount rate and membrane service life were assumed in the techno-economic analysis of the forward osmosis systems?
rendered:
A Comparative Study of Forward Osmosis Systems: An Integrated Experimental, Modeling, and Techno-Economic Analysis, page 7

The techno-economic analysis assumed a project lifetime (T) of 20 years, a discount rate (rd) of 8%, and a membrane service life of 5 years.
